# Makuo Ifedike — Portfolio

I find real problems and build working solutions fast. I look for people stuck on a real workflow problem, then design and build a functional prototype, usually in days, so you can see exactly how it would work before committing to anything. My core stack: React, Next.js, Remix, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS on the frontend, with Supabase and Sanity CMS for backend and content. Most of what I build is fully working, not just a visual mockup. Two live projects I built and shipped myself: Interior Decorators, a 30-page design agency site built to show what a premium interior decoration website should look like — CMS-driven, fast, and accessible: https://interior-deco-kappa.vercel.app — and Truespec, a dealership system for a Nigerian vehicle-import business: https://truespec.duckdns.org. I also built Athletica, a product showcase platform for an Amazon affiliate marketer who was losing sales to DM-based selling. Customers browse a real catalog, pick sizes, and build a cart. The Amazon affiliate handoff is the final piece, still in development. The owner manages everything from a drag-and-drop admin panel: https://athletica-blond.vercel.app I work independently and I'm currently building custom tools for teams and founders who have a specific workflow problem worth solving. If that's you, let's talk.

## Featured work (4 projects)

- **Truespec** — Dealership system: public showroom + private office for a Nigerian vehicle-import business. Live — flagship. https://truespec.duckdns.org/ — https://github.com/lordwhitefire/truespec
- **Athletica** — Football store and affiliate commerce platform built for a friend's affiliate business. In progress. https://athletica-blond.vercel.app/ — https://github.com/lordwhitefire/athletica
- **Interior-deco** — CMS-driven marketing site for the Whitefire Interior brand. Live. https://interior-deco-kappa.vercel.app/ — https://github.com/lordwhitefire/interior-deco
- **CP3-legacy** — Chris Paul fan site / sports experience. In progress. https://cp3-legacy.vercel.app/ — https://github.com/lordwhitefire/cp3-legacy

Whitefire Interior is the Interior-deco project's brand, not the owner's studio and not a confirmed client engagement. CP3-legacy is a fan destination, not an official affiliation. Athletica is built for a friend who runs an affiliate business — client work.
